capacity_usable_kwh.notes: mbusa "battery capacity" row, read as usable because a second page labels this same pack usable: Edmunds and Green Car Reports (per the fact-checker) describe 118 kWh as usable.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia infobox lists a 400 V system for this model (EQS 400V; EQE 400V / 328 V); uncited there.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the Mercedes USA EQE/EQS quick-start guide says (per the fact-checker excerpt; the PDF could not be read here) the battery is prepared automatically before the charging station is reached, i.e. a navigation trigger; same system on sedan and SUV. Whether a separate manual battery control exists is unproven either way (the mbusa EV FAQ mentions on-demand preconditioning from the app, possibly cabin only).
